stories.title: Bridge between Russia and occupied Crimea ‘no longer usable’ after Kyiv strike | First Thing
summary: Blow to Kremlin as prestigious bridge linking occupied Ukrainian peninsula struck by missile.
Ukraine has critically damaged the Kerch bridge linking occupied Crimea with Russia in an overnight missile attack, in what Ukrainian officials say is a symbolic blow to the Kremlin.

The strike follows an earlier attack on Monday that targeted an arch across its central section.Ukraine has declared that the Kerch bridge, built eight years ago after Vladimir Putin’s 2014 annexation of Crimea, is illegal.
